contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---]S AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE [DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius (350-353), Vow in wreath held by Victories, issue of 351-353, Reece period 18. Legend trimmed. Obverse description: bare headed bust draped right, pudding basin haircut. A behind head. Obverse inscription: [---]S AVG. Reverse description: two Victories holding wreath inscribed VOT/V/MVLT/X. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE [DD NN AVG ET CAES].…
